title: Starting a NSW tenancy
description: The paperwork and steps before and when a NSW tenant signs. Summarised from NSW Fair Trading, Service NSW and the Residential Tenancies Act 2010.

sources.title: Information a tenant should get at the start of a tenancy
What tenants need to be told about a rental property
Rental Bonds Online for self-managing landlords
How and when to pay rent

items.title: Tell the tenant about any prepared sale contract, mortgagee action or strata renewal committee
Disclose material facts such as recent flooding or bushfire, loose-fill asbestos or serious health and safety risks
Give the NSW Tenant Information Statement before the tenant signs
Prepare the agreement on the NSW standard residential tenancy agreement
Complete the NSW residential tenancy condition report and give two copies (or one electronic copy) with the agreement
items.detail: Take dated photos. The tenant returns a copy within 7 days of moving in.

items.title: Give the tenant the strata by-laws
Give the tenant a copy of the pool certificate of compliance
Invite the tenant to pay the bond through Rental Bonds Online, at most 4 weeks' rent
Set up fee-free rent payment by bank transfer and Centrepay
Ask for no more than 2 weeks' rent in advance
Give your contact details in writing, or include them in the agreement
Record the water meter reading in the condition report
Give the tenant a copy of the signed agreement
